label: Notice Manager
description: The notice a data principal actually reads. Jethur AI writes it from your RoPA, checks it against the Act, and publishes it as a hosted page you can link, embed or hand over as a PDF.
emptyDescription: Pick a processing activity and Jethur AI drafts the whole notice - purpose, data, recipients, retention and rights - from what your RoPA already says. You review it and publish.
emptyMeta: JDP-NTC · s.5 NOTICE · RULE 3 CONTENT · 4 LANGUAGES
noResultsDescription: Try a different filter or clear the search.
loadErrorDescription: Something went wrong fetching notices. Try reloading the page.
footerSourceNote: SOURCED FROM RoPA · CHECKED BY JETHUR AI · PUBLISHED AS A HOSTED PAGE
newDescription: Two ways in. If the processing is already in your RoPA, start there — the notice writes itself from evidence you have already approved.
ropaOptionDescription: Recommended — the notice matches what you already recorded
ropaPickHint: Only approved activities carry evidence — drafts can still be used.
ropaNoActivitiesText: Your RoPA has no processing activities yet — that is where the purpose, the data categories and the retention rule come from.
ropaBuildCta: Build my RoPA with Jethur AI
scratchOptionDescription: Describe the notice you need — Jethur AI drafts it and asks only what it must
scratchHint: One or two plain sentences. Name who it is for and what you do with their data.
scratchPlaceholder: e.g. Create a privacy notice for customers registering on our mobile application.
draftOnlyHint: DRAFT ONLY — YOU REVIEW EVERY SECTION BEFORE IT PUBLISHES

sourceFromScratchHint: This notice was written from your description, not from a RoPA activity. Link it to an activity to keep the two in step.
checkCardDescription: Does the notice carry everything s.5 and Rule 3 require?
checkPass: All eight sections s.5 and Rule 3 ask for are present
checkDataMatch: Personal data itemised — Rule 3 asks for an itemised description
checkRightsMatch: Rights, withdrawal and the Board route are all named

aiCardHintDefault: Click into a section, then pick an action.

ropaNoLongerInRegister: This activity is no longer in the RoPA register.

shareModalSub: Status Published · published version v{version} · {count} language{plural}
sharePublicUrlSub: Always shows the version that is currently published.
sharePublicUrlHint: Put it on your website, in your app, in the signup form, or in an email — wherever the notice has to reach someone.
shareEmbedSub: Renders the live notice inside your own page.
shareOfflineSub: The same published notice as a document.
langModalSub: Section 5(3) lets a data principal read the notice in English or any of the 22 languages in the Eighth Schedule. Jethur AI translates from your approved English source and keeps the structure intact.
langModalAiNote: AI means Jethur has no reviewed heading set for that language yet — headings stay in English until a native reviewer confirms them.
